scientific_role: single-subject fixed-sensor total beta-power method control
paper_anchor: Pfurtscheller and Lopes da Silva (1999), section 3.1 and Figure 3: per-trial power then trial average and 100*(A-R)/R; not reproduction of a figure's numerical finding
channel_policy: Keep all source gradiometers when constructing/applying source SSP projections and epochs; only then select the four readout sensors. Fail if a readout is absent, marked bad, or has nonfinite retained data. No extra filtering, resampling, amplitude rejection, channel interpolation or trial selection.

morlet.normalization: MNE1.12.1 discrete wavelet L2 norm sqrt(2)
morlet.convolution: linear zero-padded same, no reflect or wrap

time_policy: Inclusive comparisons on unrounded source sampling times; offset samples round(tmin*sfreq)..round(tmax*sfreq), inclusive. time_index starts at0; event_sample and epoch bounds use original absolute sample clock including first_samp.
aggregation: P[e,c,f,t]=abs(convolution)^2; A[c,f,t]=mean_e(P); B[c,f]=mean_baseline(A)>0; pct[c,f,t]=100*(A/B-1); curve[t]=mean_c,f(pct); endpoint=mean_target(curve). Never normalize each trial before averaging or normalize after pooling sensors/frequencies.
interpretation: Descriptive total power includes phase-locked and non-phase-locked activity. Fixed sensor selection does not establish source localization or laterality. No population inference, isolated induced component, baseline oscillation validation or precise onset inference. No required sign or effect size. Gaussian temporal sigma is about79.6ms with support approximately plus/minus398ms; epoch endpoints have edge effects.
scoring: Binary correctness of complete source-bound numerical receipts; no prose keywords, correlation shortcut or model-difficulty claim.
